content:
Priya M: quick UX nit from my convo with support — retention + region + KMS labels are confusing in Project Settings. Users keep asking whether retention is per-region or global, and the KMS badge doesn't show which key/region. Can we tidy copy & tab order? :eyes:

Sam K: yeah i've seen this in two onboarding calls. Current labels are short but ambiguous. i propose we expand helper copy and show explicit key ownership + region.

Priya M: proposed copy (feel free to tweak):
```
Label: "Data retention period"
Helper: "Applies to logs, traces, and analytics. Embeddings and model artifacts may be stored in the selected storage region."
Region label: "Storage region for embeddings & artifacts"
KMS badge: "KMS: customer-managed — us-east-1 (key id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd)"
```
These are intentionally explicit so support can point customers to the exact behavior.

Jorge L: small accessibility / focus-order issue: tab order currently focuses Region -> Retention -> Save button -> KMS toggle. We should ensure keyboard flow is Region -> KMS -> Retention -> Save. Quick JS patch: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-settings]').forEach((el,i)=>el.tabIndex = i+1)` but i'll make a cleaner data-attribute plan if we decide.

Sam K: +1 to ordering change. Also for audit log timestamps, screen readers read relative times oddly. Suggest adding `aria-label` with full ISO time on hover/for SR: `<time datetime="2025-09-10T14:23:00Z" aria-label="September 10, 2025 at 2:23 PM UTC">2h ago</time>`.

Ana V: do we want to show KMS region on the badge or inside a details popover? badge space is tight. Could be badge + info icon that opens a small panel with key id, owner, region, and rotation policy.

Priya M: info popover sounds good — badge shows "KMS: customer-managed" + `:information_source:`. Popover fields: Key owner, Key region, Key id (masked), Rotation policy. Also add a copy string for the popover CTA: "View KMS details".

Sam K: note: we need a short audit-text update too. current audit log entry: `KMS key changed` -> ambiguous. propose: `KMS configuration updated: key rotated by Priya M (us-east-1)`. keeps it searchable.

Jorge L: will volunteer to implement tabindex reordering + aria labels. i'll open a PR with a11y tests.

Priya M: thanks Jorge. action items: Sam will draft final copy + audit phrasing, Jorge will PR focus/aria changes, Ana will mock popover placement vs badge, i'll coordinate with support for messaging.

Sam K: draft copy attached — small variants, pick preferred:```
- "Data retention period (applies to logs, traces, analytics). Embeddings stored in selected region."
- "Data retention window — affects usage logs and analytics. Embeddings follow storage region setting."
```

Ana V: i prefer the first. shorter and more scannable.

design-bot: new mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/kms-retention-popover — comments open. :sparkles:

Priya M: timeline? i'd like this in the next sprint for a support doc sync.

Jorge L: aiming PR today -> review tomorrow -> deploy to staging by Thu.

Sam K: i'll put the copy in the docs PR after design signoff.

Ana V: tagging @Design for final microcopy review.

Priya M: perfect. thanks everyone! :heart:
